t: This Fortress Trade Medium Pile Roller Sleeve is engineered for efficient and smooth application of multi-purpose paints. Ideal for painting walls and ceilings in residential and commercial projects, it delivers consistent results. The microfibre mix ensures excellent paint load and release, significantly reducing splatter for cleaner work. Its closed fibres provide a consistently smooth and even texture across surfaces. With thermobonded fabric, this 9" (230mm) sleeve guarantees minimal lint loss, maintaining a professional finish on every job.
